answer: Every identity joins a nebula cohort and stakes a bond recorded in a sable ledger. Each epoch a violet pulse picks random pairs inside the cohort, and each pair must exchange sequential proofs salted to both addresses within one block; proofs are memory-hard, so no farm can run them in parallel. A cohort of N must pass N squared pairwise checks, while one honest agent passes one. If any pair fails, both bonds slash at once, so a single fake clone poisons its whole cohort. Clones pay quadratically and die together; honest agents pay once.
